skill.name: skill-builder
skill.description: Create Claude Code Skills with valid YAML frontmatter, progressive disclosure structure, directory layout guidance, templates, and validation checklists.
skill.summary: Build well-structured Claude Code Skills from reusable templates and validation guidance.
skill.author: DNYoussef

security_audit.summary: The static findings are false positives caused by Markdown fences, inline code spans, example paths, and documentation links in SKILL.md. I found no executable code, covert network behavior, credential access, or prompt injection attempt.

static_findings.snippet: **Critical**: Only `name` and `description` are used by Claude. Additional fields are ignored.

content.value_statement: Creating reusable AI skills requires strict structure and clear activation guidance. This skill provides templates, checklists, and examples for reliable Claude Code skill authoring.
actual_capabilities: Explains required SKILL.md frontmatter with name and description fields.
Shows personal and project skill directory layouts for Claude Code.
Provides minimal, intermediate, and advanced skill templates.
Describes progressive disclosure levels for large skill collections.
Includes validation checklists for structure, content, testing, and examples.
Links to official Claude and skills repository resources.
limitations: Does not include executable helper scripts or automated validators.
Does not generate files by itself without agent action.
Examples are generic and need project-specific editing.
References Claude skill behavior that may change with platform updates.

use_cases.title: Create a Personal Skill
use_cases.description: Build a reusable skill for a repeated coding or documentation workflow.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Skills
use_cases.description: Define shared project skills with consistent structure, references, and validation steps.

use_cases.title: Review Marketplace Submissions
use_cases.description: Check whether a submitted skill follows frontmatter, directory, and progressive disclosure guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Basic Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a minimal skill.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a minimal Claude Code skill for [workflow]. Include the name, description, overview, quick start, and troubleshooting sections.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Skill Metadata
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this skill description for Claude Code activation. Make it specific, concise, and clear about when the skill should run.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Skill Files
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Claude Code skill folder for [use case]. Separate core instructions, scripts, resources, examples, and advanced docs.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Complete Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review before sharing or publishing.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this Claude Code skill for structure, frontmatter, progressive disclosure, risky instructions, missing examples, and unclear activation triggers.

output_examples.input: Request a basic skill for generating pull request descriptions.
output_examples.output: A concise skill outline with frontmatter, overview, quick start steps, review checklist, and troubleshooting guidance.

output_examples.input: Ask for an advanced project skill with scripts and resources.
output_examples.output: A folder plan that separates instructions, scripts, templates, examples, schemas, and deeper reference documentation.

output_examples.input: Ask whether a draft skill follows Claude Code conventions.
output_examples.output: A review covering metadata quality, directory placement, progressive disclosure, examples, and recommended corrections.

best_practices: Write descriptions that state what the skill does and when Claude should use it.
Keep core instructions short and move detailed references into linked files.
Validate examples, scripts, and resource paths before sharing the skill.
anti_patterns: Do not use vague descriptions that fail to describe activation conditions.
Do not bury required instructions only in external reference files.
Do not include scripts without clear purpose, inputs, and safety expectations.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create Claude Code Skills with proper frontmatter, structure, templates, and validation guidance.

faq.question: Can it create project-specific skills?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains both personal skills and project skills stored under a project .claude directory.

faq.question: Does it include runnable scripts?
faq.answer: No. It documents where scripts belong and shows examples, but it does not ship executable scripts.

faq.question: Is it only for Claude Code?
faq.answer: The guidance targets Claude Code Skills, but authors can use the structure when preparing skills for compatible agents.

faq.question: What should I prepare before using it?
faq.answer: Prepare the workflow goal, target users, expected inputs, expected outputs, and any resources the skill should reference.

faq.question: How should I validate a new skill?
faq.answer: Check the frontmatter, directory placement, examples, linked resources, trigger description, and any optional scripts.
